about.title: Living Soil Biotechnology
about.intro: Green Science is the bio-input sub-line of Bioagrosolutions, a Bolivian company dedicated to the development, formulation and production of microbial organic agricultural bio-inputs. From Montero, Santa Cruz, we bring beneficial-microorganism technology to the field to build living soils and a more sustainable agriculture.
about.missionText: To offer effective biological alternatives to chemical inputs, improving soil health and farmer profitability without leaving toxic residues.
about.approachText: We work with consortia of beneficial bacteria and fungi that feed the plant, fix nitrogen, solubilize nutrients and control pests and diseases biologically. That is what we call Living Soil Biotechnology: bringing the soil back to life.
about.whatText: They are products formulated from selected living microorganisms (bacteria, fungi and actinomycetes) that perform specific functions in the soil and the plant: they stimulate growth, improve nutrition and provide biological control, in balance with the ecosystem.
